theme.description: A highly functional, mobile-first PWA designed for rural restaurant owners. It borrows the trust, simplicity, and color-coded clarity of apps like KhataBook. Emphasizes legibility, large touch targets, and stark contrast between success (green) and danger (red).

spacing_and_layout.cards: bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-4 shadow-sm
spacing_and_layout.buttons: h-12 sm:h-14 px-6 rounded-lg font-medium w-full flex items-center justify-center
spacing_and_layout.inputs: h-12 w-full rounded-lg border-gray-300 bg-gray-50 px-4 text-base focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-transparent

components.bottom_nav: Fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-16 bg-white border-t border-gray-200 flex justify-around items-center z-50 max-w-md mx-auto shadow-[0_-4px_6px_-1px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]
components.fab: Fixed bottom-20 right-4 sm:right-auto sm:ml-[350px] h-14 w-14 bg-primary text-white rounded-full shadow-lg flex items-center justify-center z-40
components.kpi_card: Flex flex-col justify-between p-4 bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200. Value should use large font (text-2xl font-bold) and distinct color (e.g., text-green-600 for profit).
components.list_item: Flex justify-between items-center p-4 bg-white border-b border-gray-100 active:bg-gray-50
components.status_badge: Inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-gray-100 text-gray-800

interactions_and_motion.hover: Not a priority as this is a mobile-first touch interface.
interactions_and_motion.active: active:scale-[0.98] active:bg-gray-50 transition-all duration-75 (Immediate feedback for rural users)
interactions_and_motion.feedback: Use Sonner for toasts. Toasts must be at the TOP for mobile so they don't get blocked by keyboards or bottom nav.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast ratios exceed 4.5:1. Avoid light gray text on white.
accessibility.touch: All interactive elements must be at least 48x48px.
accessibility.language: UI must gracefully handle Hindi/Telugu strings which may be longer than English. Do not hardcode fixed widths.
accessibility.indicators: Never rely on color alone. Use icons (e.g., ArrowUp for profit, ArrowDown for loss) alongside Red/Green colors.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

images.description: Two men stand outside a restaurant with a scooter.
Cooked food on white ceramic plate (Biryani)

instructions_to_main_agent: Build as a Mobile-First PWA: Default layout should be constrained to `max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-gray-50 relative`.
Use standard Tailwind utilities. Do not overcomplicate the CSS.
Implement bottom navigation for primary tabs: Home, Sales, Inventory, Menu.
Implement OTP login screen natively simulating phone number entry.
Color codes are critical for this audience: Green = Cash In/Profit, Red = Cash Out/Loss/Alert. Use them heavily in the UI to indicate status without reading.
Language support (English/Hindi/Telugu) implies you should setup a simple i18n structure or at least structure text in a way that is easily replaceable.
Avoid Shadcn 'Card' overhead if a simple div does the job, but use Shadcn for complex inputs like Select, Dialog, or Tabs.
All forms should have large touch targets (h-12 minimum for inputs and buttons).
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, form inputs, menus, error messages, and confirmation texts using kebab-case role-based names.
